topics.topic: Whether check_value_forms must expose the successfully parsed Decimal, or the Decimal-preservation requirement must be removed or reassigned
questions: Must check_value_forms only validate and return refusal failures, or must its contract and return model change so that the parsed Decimal can be retained and observed?

Must the requirement stop requiring check_value_forms to keep or expose the parsed Decimal, or must the contract return a successful parsed value through which its exact Decimal representation can be observed?

The contract can return only refusal failures and exposes no Decimal for a passing value, so a test cannot show that its Decimal was kept exactly as written; must the preservation requirement be removed, assigned to _read_decimal_text, or supported by a changed return contract?

quotes: _read_decimal_text: [RETURN_SHAPE] MUST answer, for text in the number form of the JSON data interchange format with no minus sign and no exponent, the Decimal of that text, its digits and its scale as written, and MUST answer None, raising nothing, for any other text, a sign, an exponent, a decimal comma, white space, a full stop with no digit before or after it and a leading zero before another digit included.

check_value_forms: [BEHAVIOR] MUST check only the length of an alias, never its characters, and MUST answer an empty tuple when every form value is within its form; every given value it receives is present, an absent value never reaching it.
judgement.why: The contract makes check_value_forms a validator returning only refusal failures, while _read_decimal_text already owns preservation of the parsed Decimal's written digits and scale, so check_value_forms need not expose that Decimal.

topics.topic: Whether model iteration is allowed inside an imported operation and, if so, which operation
questions: Either name and list the imported operation that may iterate the model, or remove the allowance for performing the iteration inside an imported operation.

quotes:
a model's fields read generically come from iterating the model,
  in place or inside an imported operation that does so.
judgement.why: The static gate expressly permits model iteration either directly or inside any imported operation that performs that iteration, so no particular operation must be enumerated.

topics.topic: Define the contract for converting a position to canonical decimal text
questions: Replace the reference to Python's str with an observable requirement for the position's canonical decimal text, or declare the conversion as a separate imported port/contract.

quotes: _write_form_path: [RETURN_SHAPE] MUST answer the text of path's elements in their order with the imported OWNER_FORM_PATH_SEPARATOR constant between each two and nowhere else: an element's name, the name of a part of a row of the imported OWNER_FORM_FIELDS constant, written as it stands and, for an element with no name, its position, a tuple's position counted from zero, written as the text Python's str gives for that position, which read_digits_text answers as that position.
judgement.why: The note makes Python's str the exact conversion mechanism inside prose instead of stating the observable canonical-decimal result or declaring that conversion as a separate port or contract.
judgement.rule: Если точный внешний способ извлечения значения является частью контракта, он объявляется отдельным портом/контрактом, а не прячется псевдокодом в note.

author_guidance: Before editing, identify the decision's owning state from the phase purpose, question_scope and layer obligations, then choose a disposition for each topic that awaits one.
fixed: repair a decision the owning state must make; do not add later-layer implementation choices merely to close a topic. Record the fix commit and review the changed text once.

carried: name the receiving layer and use --what to preserve the choice, its options and consequences, and the required guarantee every option must keep. Decide any guarantee owned here before carrying its execution onward.
accepted: explain why the remaining choice is permitted. Bring an unresolved product choice to the owner with its options and consequences; absence of a quoted requirement does not decide it.
contradiction and standard_violation take no disposition: repair the offending text in its owning state and review the change. Deterministic transition findings must also close through their checks.
